data.one_liner: Collection of useful static extension methods for Dart core types.
data.what_it_does: Adds a rich set of Kotlin-inspired extension methods to common Dart classes like Iterable, String, int, num, Function, File, and Directory. It simplifies common data manipulation tasks such as slicing, sorting by multiple properties, string capitalization, and file path handling.
use_when: You want Kotlin-style collection and string operations in Dart.
You need convenient utilities for files, directories, and time manipulation.
avoid_when: You prefer to keep your dependencies minimal and write small custom extension methods yourself.
You only need standard Dart library methods.
strengths: Extensive collection of helpful extension methods for built-in types.
Includes time utilities and file system helpers.
Easy to integrate with zero configuration.
weaknesses: Adds global extensions to core types which might cause naming collisions if not imported carefully.
Large surface area for a utility package.
